actions.action: Check flowers for green swelling at base
Hand-pollinate or shake flowering stems each morning
Check soil moisture daily and water deeply when top 2-3 cm dry
Move planter to sunniest spot or rotate for afternoon sun
Shade pot from harsh afternoon heat if very hot
Feed with low-nitrogen flowering fertilizer every 2 weeks

reason: The plant was simply too young and needed time, but the answer blames light, pollination, heat and nitrogen and prescribes fixes; these are unnecessary but mostly benign and would not really delay fruiting.
